kind_of_thing.why: The sources describe it as a small appliance with a handle and flat surface that people make and use to press clothes.

kind_of_made_thing.quote: A clothes iron, also known as a flatiron, smoothing iron, dry iron, steam iron, and simply iron, is a small appliance that, when heated, is used to press clothes to remove wrinkles and unwanted creases.

kind_of_house_thing.why: The sources say electricity makes the flat surface hot, so it is a household thing that runs on electricity.
